queries: WITH account_figures AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS average_signed_amount, AVG(balance) AS average_balance FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY account_id) SELECT AVG(average_signed_amount) AS average_signed_amount_across_accounts, AVG(average_balance) AS average_balance_across_accounts FROM account_figures

WITH account_averages AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY account_id) SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount_across_accounts, AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_balance_across_accounts FROM account_averages

WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY account_id) SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount_across_accounts, AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_balance_across_accounts FROM per_account;
